name: PDH/PDL Retest Scalping
description: Rule-based PDH/PDL strategy: breakout above Previous Day High or below Previous Day Low, entry on retracement. Grid search optimizes retracement level, trading hours, and TP multiplier.
hypothesis: PDH/PDL breakouts with retracement produce high-probability intraday setups. Optimizer finds best retracement level (0.3-0.7), trading hour window, and TP via grid search.
expected_outcome: Trades only on retest signals after confirmed breakout above PDH or below PDL. Max 1 entry per direction per day.
